## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filter (used in ~95% of queries)
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'

-- Multi-region filter
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region IN ('BR', 'ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN')
  AND grass_date = DATE'${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: JOIN on shop_id + grass_region (most common, used in dim_advertiser, dim_shop_info, etc.)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, shop_id,
        shop_level1_global_be_category, shop_level2_global_be_category,
        shop_level1_fe_display_category, shop_level1_kpi_category,
        shop_level2_fe_display_category, shop_level2_kpi_category
    FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${BIZ_YESTERDAY}')
      AND grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
      AND tz_type = '${tz_type}'
) category
ON advertiser.shop_id = category.shop_id
AND advertiser.grass_region = category.grass_region

-- Pattern 2: JOIN on shop_id only (used in dim_shop_info for category enrichment)
LEFT JOIN shop_listing d ON a.shop_id = d.shop_id
-- where shop_listing is pre-aggregated:
CACHE TABLE shop_listing
SELECT shop_id,
    FIRST(shop_level1_global_be_category) AS shop_level1_global_be_category,
    FIRST(shop_level2_global_be_category) AS shop_level2_global_be_category,
    FIRST(shop_level1_fe_display_category_id) AS shop_level1_fe_display_category_id
FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date = '${grass_date}'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY shop_id

-- Pattern 3: Category-level aggregation for Brand Ads CPM (L1/L2 category ROI)
SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, shop_id, shop_level2_global_be_category_id
FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND grass_region IN ('${REGION}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
-- then LEFT JOIN with shop-level performance for category-level ROI calculation

-- Pattern 4: USING clause JOIN (incentive wide tables)
LEFT JOIN final_main_cate USING (grass_date, grass_region, shop_id)
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Pattern 1: Shop-level category (FIRST) + active flag (most common in incentive tables)
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, shop_id,
    FIRST(shop_level1_global_be_category_id) AS l1_category,
    FIRST(shop_level2_global_be_category_id) AS l2_category,
    MAX(IF(active_item_cnt > 0, 1, 0)) AS is_active
FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, shop_id

-- Pattern 2: DISTINCT shop + category (used for category-level ROI in Brand Ads CPM)
SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, shop_id,
    shop_level2_global_be_category_id,
    shop_level1_global_be_category_id
FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live

-- Pattern 3: StarRocks sync (simple column select, no aggregation)
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, shop_id, active_item_cnt
FROM hive_metastore_catalog.mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__${region}_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = UPPER('${region}')
  AND grass_date = '${BIZ_YESTERDAY}'
```

### Snippet 3: Brand Ads CPM - L2 category ROI aggregation (workflows/search_brand_ads/cpm_calculation)

```sql
SELECT l2_cate.grass_region, l2_cate.shop_level2_global_be_category_id,
    SUM(broad_order_cnt) AS broad_order_cnt,
    SUM(broad_gmv_amt_local) / SUM(expenditure_amt_local) AS broad_roi
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT grass_region, shop_id, shop_level2_global_be_category_id
    FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
      AND grass_region IN ('${REGION}')
      AND tz_type = "local"
) l2_cate
LEFT OUTER JOIN tmp_shop_broad_roi ON l2_cate.shop_id = shop_roi.shop_id
GROUP BY l2_cate.grass_region, l2_cate.shop_level2_global_be_category_id;
```

### Snippet 4: Incentive strategy - shop listing with activity flag (workflows/incentive/wide_table)

```sql
WITH shop_listing AS (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, shop_id,
        FIRST(shop_level1_global_be_category_id) AS l1_category,
        FIRST(shop_level2_global_be_category_id) AS l2_category,
        MAX(IF(active_item_cnt > 0, 1, 0)) AS is_active
    FROM mp_item.dws_shop_listing_td__reg_s0_live
    WHERE tz_type = 'local'
      AND grass_region IN ('BR','ID','MY','PH','SG','TH','TW','VN')
      AND grass_date = DATE'${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
-- then joined with 10+ other dimension/metric tables for wide table construction
```
